decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording the requested four-by-four badge layout; no additional update or removal is needed.
Removing the Legend badge from the displayed catalog and approving eight catalog badges does not change the referral milestones, award destination, or on-chain recording rules.
The badge catalog count and Legend exclusion do not alter the Small Block prize amount, winner count, cadence, eligibility, or funding rules.
The badge catalog decision does not affect the deferred Transak provider, payment methods, conversion, access, or mint flow.
The badge catalog decision does not change the landing-page book cover's inclusion, placement, size, or visibility.
The badge catalog decision does not alter wallet creation, custody, access, destination, or reward-holding behavior for fiat buyers.
The approved badge count and removal of the Legend badge do not change Small Block ticket issuance, eligibility, weighting, reset, or carryover rules.
Although the source message also changes invalid-code copy, the badge catalog decision does not change which referral codes are valid or the self-referral prohibition.
The number and composition of catalog badges do not change the requirement to show each NFT's awarded prize-ticket count in the dashboard.

The candidate only requires permanent badges generally to remain visible in metadata; excluding Legend from the badge catalog does not negate that visibility rule or require removal of any existing candidate key.
The badge catalog count and Legend exclusion do not affect the primary mint price or founder, affiliate, and prize-pool allocations.
The badge catalog decision does not change the rule that the dashboard must list only successfully minted NFTs actually owned by the user.
